message: 探検、ぼくの学園

name: Synn
message: 「What a bother」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not really a bother, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I guess it's fine if you put it that way, though...」
Kira Fest ended to great acclaim.
As the Student Council, we are pushing forward toward making the next big event, the Holy Night Festival, a success.
However, there is still a considerable amount of time until it's held, so right now you could call it the preparation stage for the preparation for the preparation for the preparation.

name: Synn
message: 「I want to talk to Ria-senpai about it, though it's not really a big enough deal to call her over the school-wide PA system...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's low priority too, so things like this are tricky, huh, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't ask the great me about that stuff.」
I used my free time to look around for Ria-senpai, but I couldn't find her.

name: Synn
message: 「She wasn't at Prier either, so I wonder if she already went back to the Kujou residence?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's bag was still left in the Student Council room, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the thing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey Paqy, why don't you sniff out Ria-senpai's lingering scent and lead me to her?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look, I'm definitely head over heels for Ria-chan, but I don't have any perverted special abilities like that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Besides, y'know? If you just wait in the Student Council room while doing your work, Ria-chan's bound to come back, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... yeah, I guess that makes sense」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, from here on out--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」
「Guess who♪」
T-These two soft sensations hitting me square in the back are, without a doubt--
「Guess who~?」
Pressed against my chest... directly over my heart without a hair's breadth of error, this rod-shaped object is most likely a folding fan.

name: Ria
message: 「Hii, it's Ria-senpai\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I knew it」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you, President」

name: Synn
message: 「...Why is there bloodlust radiating from your folding fan?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, whatever could you mean?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Ria-chan, you just came out of the new school building, didn't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, I did?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? I literally just finished doing a full sweep through the school building. But neither of you senpai were anywhere to be found」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, ahahahaha...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai? Why the wry smile... Gasp!? I-I-I-I-I'm so sorry!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「President, what are you apologizing for? We didn't go to the restroom, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, then we must have just missed each other」

name: Ria
message: 「Wrong again. You see, Synn-kun, we were...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-daa! Believe it or not, on the third floor」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, hold on a second! Both the new and old school buildings only go up to the second floor, don't they?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I thought the exact same thing until a mere thirty minutes ago. That the bay windows visible on the roof were just for show」

name: Ria
message: 「As it turns out, that wasn't the case, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「We found a hidden staircase just now and explored the third-floor attic, hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-There's a hidden floor like that!? How do you get up there?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehehe, I'd love to tell you, Synn-kun, but... this much is a secret♪」

name: Ria
message: 「'It's way cooler if you find it yourself. Right, kid?'」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I have to track down the location of the hidden staircase on my own?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There wasn't anything on the third floor, though it truly was a splendid time」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you happen to be lucky enough to find it, why not bring someone you're close with along?」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, I have club activities to attend, so please excuse me」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, I'm heading to the Student Council room too. See you later, Akane-chan」
Ria-senpai and Misasagi-senpai head off in separate directions.
I alternately examine the decorative windows of the new Auroiaere building and the old Erereto building.
Having spent a year and a half of academy life without paying any mind to the attic, will I actually be able to make it to the third floor?
In the first place, what prompted Ria-senpai to discover the hidden staircase?

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... It means Ria-chan and that black-tights chick are best friends」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't have hard proof, but Ria-chan is Helena's little sister, right? She probably knew about it even before enrolling, didn't she?」

name: Paqy
message: 「So, right before graduation, she let Kurosto in on the secret and nobody else... Something like that, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That sounds just like her.」

name: Paqy
message: 「By the way, Synn-sama? Didn't you have some business with Ria-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, crap!!」

name: Lolotte's Voice
message: 「Mr. President, Mr. President. We're out of tea leaves. Where do you keep the spare stock?」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't ask something like that over the school-wide broadcast!」

name: Ria's Voice
message: 「L-Lolotte-chan... Bad girl!」
Amidst the ripples of laughter echoing throughout Ryuusei Academy, I dash toward the Student Council room.
